messages:
mira: FYI I opened a docs PR to add the status page link + a short workaround for yesterday's inference outage. Need a quick review and a green docs-preview so we can merge before EOD.
alex: Which PR? link?
mira: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/482 — changes: add status.redwood.com link to /operational/incidents, Known Issue blurb about KV-cache invalidation on autoscaler failover, and an SDK retry snippet + small workaround steps.
sam: I can review content but preview CI was failing earlier for this repo.
docs-bot: docs-preview failed for PR #482 — build error: missing include file 'incidents/snippets/status-link.md'. Full log: "ERROR: include file not found: incidents/snippets/status-link.md"
jordan: I can take the prose pass. Quick ask: please explicitly call out that Dedicated customers may observe queued requests during model fallback.
mira: Added that note and pushed a fix; re-ran the preview (gh pr ready).
deploy-bot: Preview published: https://deploy-preview-482--docs.redwood.com — please review the live changes.
alex: LGTM overall. Nit: SDK snippet uses `timeout` param; please use `timeout_ms` for the Python SDK. Suggested snippet:
```python
client.generate(model="redwood-7b", prompt="...", timeout_ms=120000)
```
(also mark the code block as python)
mira: Fixed the snippet and force-pushed.
sam: I'll do a quick smoke against staging once the preview is promoted; if green I'll merge. ETA ~15m. @deploy-bot can you promote the preview to staging?
deploy-bot: Promotion to staging started for PR #482 — expected ~5m. Status: queued -> in-progress.
sre_kate: Quick ops ask: include the monitoring query we used to detect the spike and a permalink to the status incident. Suggest adding under "How we detect it":
```promql
sum(rate(inference_errors_total[5m])) by (model)
```
Also add status link: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/2025-03-14-inference-failover
mira: Added the monitoring query + status permalink and merged to main (hotfix branch merge). Opening a backport PR to /ops for the internal runbook.
merge-bot: PR #482 merged into main by mira at 1758004400. Changelog entry queued; notifying #incidents to update timeline.
alex: Thanks everyone — I'll ping support to surface a KB article referencing the new docs. :thumbsup:
mira: Thanks team. I'll follow up with a short postmortem doc and a "what changed" blurb for the release notes.
